exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "Verb -saserareru (passive causative)".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! 動詞させられる matches "Verb -saserareru (passive causative)".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is 動詞させられる.
exercises.explanation: Expresses being made or forced by someone to do an action.
